name: society-mgmt-300k-nested
description: Synthetic ~300K-line Node.js codebase (society management) used for backprop/scale integration testing. Plain JavaScript with no runtime dependencies and no module system; source is delivered in society_mgmt_300k.zip.

scripts.extract: python3 -c "import zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile('society_mgmt_300k.zip').extractall('.'); print('Source extracted from society_mgmt_300k.zip')"
scripts.build: find src tests -type f -name '*.js' -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 -r -n1 -P4 node --check && echo 'Syntax check passed (node --check).'
